leadText:
Angela (Japanese: イチコ Ichiko) is a character of the day who appeared in the episode From Cradle to Save. She is the teacher of a Pokémon Ninja School located in a forest, and is a very skillful ninja.

 and met her when Evian took them to the Pokémon Ninja School. jumped toward her, but seconds later, she appeared as a substitution of herself as a log with similar clothing. She revealed herself in a nearby treetop, amazing all the students with her actions. She presided over a training session with Ash and his friends as special students.

When the school was under attack by , Angela sent her into , destroying the trio's mecha. Jessie attacked her by running around uncontrollably and creating many clones of herself. Angela had Shiftry use , which created a effect, rotating Team Rocket at a high speed. An entangled the trio with its web, trapping them inside and they were rolled off a nearby cliff with the ball of webbing.
